import bpy,json
from mathutils import Vector,Matrix
from pathlib import Path
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['shipyard_craft']
exec(r'''
c=collection('Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft')
front_limit=2.85;rear_shift=3.10
manifest=[]
exclude_a=('A rear workshop','A workshop','A facade pier','A doorway','A door timber','A jamb shoe','A lintel','A inside workshop','A roof','A repair fascia','A reveal fastener','A back foundation','A foundation return')
clip_a=('A terrace core','A terrace paving','A external retaining','A basin foundation')
for ob in bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_A_Craft'].objects:
 if ob.name.startswith(exclude_a):continue
 coords=[ob.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in ob.bound_box]
 if ob.name.startswith('A creeping salt plant') and (min(p.z for p in coords)>3 or min(p.y for p in coords)>front_limit):continue
 if ob.name.startswith(clip_a) and min(p.y for p in coords)>front_limit-.04:continue
 cp=ob.copy();cp.data=ob.data.copy();cp.name='Combined_front_'+ob.name;c.objects.link(cp);cp.matrix_world=ob.matrix_world.copy()
 if ob.name.startswith(clip_a) and max(p.y for p in coords)>front_limit:
  inv=cp.matrix_world.inverted()
  for v in cp.data.vertices:
   q=cp.matrix_world@v.co;q.y=min(q.y,front_limit);v.co=inv@q
  cp.data.update()
  for uv in list(cp.data.uv_layers):cp.data.uv_layers.remove(uv)
  uv_project(cp,.8)
 cp['source_component']=ob.name;manifest.append({'source':ob.name,'section':'A_drydock'})
exclude_b=('B apron','B quay','B braced pier','B pier ','B right finger','B finger ','B bollard','B coiled mooring','B mooring','B alongside repair ship','B outside service bench','B pivoting loading crane','B reveal fastener')
for ob in bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_B_Craft'].objects:
 if ob.name.startswith(exclude_b):continue
 coords=[ob.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in ob.bound_box]
 if ob.name.startswith(('B parts crate','B supply barrel')) and min(p.y for p in coords)<0:continue
 cp=ob.copy();cp.data=ob.data.copy();cp.name='Combined_rear_'+ob.name;c.objects.link(cp);cp.matrix_world=Matrix.Translation((0,rear_shift,0))@ob.matrix_world
 cp['source_component']=ob.name;manifest.append({'source':ob.name,'section':'B_workshop','offset_y':rear_shift})
# Three stone treads form the usable connection from the drydock bed to the workshop.
for i in range(3):
 top=1.24+i*.18;box('Combined inner access stone step',(0,1.65+i*.37,(.98+top)/2),(2.48,.39,top-.98),stone,.024)
box('Combined workshop threshold',(0,2.77,1.52),(2.48,.42,.16),stone,.022)
# Edge stones bridge the narrow join around the doorway without obstructing the slip.
for x in [-2.2,2.2]:box('Combined threshold side paving',(x,2.68,1.53),(1.35,.33,.18),stone,.021)
# Use the A yard hoist and boat, with the B building's original windows, lamps and sign.
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
assert len([o for o in c.objects if 'Closed lower timber hull' in o.name])==1
assert not any('alongside repair ship' in o.name or 'repair fascia' in o.name for o in c.objects)
p=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent/'captures'/'shipyard_combined_20261110'/'combination_manifest.json';p.write_text(json.dumps({'components':manifest,'new_connection':'three stone steps and doorway threshold','rear_shift':rear_shift,'front_clip_y':front_limit},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('COMBINED_SAVED',len(c.objects),'components')
''',ns)
